identity.title: [v0.92.1][V3-01] Freeze Product Contract And Retained Invariants

values.goal: Establish the immutable product, command, state, output, safety, and parity contracts that every later issue implements.
values.required_outcome: command schema capability recovery and parity contract review is produced at an exact revision and independently reproducible.
declared_scope: The public command tree, versioned requests/results, exit taxonomy, canonical state fields, card projections, topology ownership, review, publication linkage, finish, cleanup, migration, and supported-platform matrix.
authority_boundary: Issue V3-01 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main
Bind only after typed doctor reports ready
Do not cross dependency or stop gates
Keep evidence producer-derived and exact-revision bound
